summary: chore(init): add project blueprint and context files

decisions.title: Use blueprint-first repository initialization
decisions.rationale: The repository has no source code yet, so the agreed product direction and stack were recorded first as the implementation baseline.
tradeoffs: Adds documentation and context files before executable modules exist
assumptions: The initial stack is React Web + Java Spring Boot + PostgreSQL + MyBatis-Plus with Agent and React Native planned later

rejected_alternatives.option: Wait for source code before documenting architecture
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would lose the agreed decisions and make later implementation less consistent

side_effects: CLAUDE.md and .claude/index.json now describe planned architecture rather than scanned modules

decisions.title: Initialize .context decision tracking from day one
decisions.rationale: Shared workflow rules and durable decision history should exist before feature development starts.
tradeoffs: Introduces extra repository metadata to maintain
assumptions: Only history files are committed while current branch logs remain local

rejected_alternatives.option: Keep decisions only in chat history
rejected_alternatives.reason: Chat history is not a stable project artifact for future tooling or collaboration

side_effects: The repository now includes context preferences and history scaffolding
